question: How do dreams reveal the relativity of space and time within waking assumptions?
premises: What is assumed to be waking occurs within limited space and a limited watch of time.
Within that same span, separate dreams can occur.
Those dreams have their own varied measures of space and time.
inference: The measures of space and time are not fixed by waking assumptions, since distinct dream worlds generate their own.
plain_english: Within what is taken as waking, in a span of three and a half cubits and a single watch of time, separate dreams arise with their own varied measures of space and time.
